translation: Buru min kɛra kɛmɛ-fo, a kɔnɔ buru-kaɲɛw (kɛmɛflen buru) kan, ale bɛna i n'a fɔ a sarakabɔlan min bɛna laso min bɛ o sarakabɔlan kɛ walasa a yaw bɛ a bolo, ale bɛna laso (ani ale bɛna laso fɛn minnu bɛ ka kan kɛ saraka ye minnu bɛ Ale Yaw tɔgɔ la), awa a bɛna ⟨את⟩ sarakaw minnu bɛ laso don a yɛrɛ la, o bɛɛ bɛna kɛ ɲɔgɔn ye.

tokens.gloss: i n'a fɔ a sarakabɔlan min bɛna laso
hɛrɛlaso min bɛ Ale Yaw tɔgɔ la
